ops.text: Mechanism: the KERNEL's csblob_parse_teamid does read teamID as a raw string with no cert cross-check (research correct), BUT exec-time validation of a non-platform Developer ID binary runs through amfid -> Security.framework verifySignature() -> errSecCSBadTeamIdentifier, which enforces OU==teamID and causes AMFI to SIGKILL a forged-team binary BEFORE it runs. So enforcement is at the exec gate, upstream of any live peer. A peer that is running + category 6 therefore cannot report a forged foreign team. Not bypassable by a same-UID attacker on a SIP-enabled machine (the threat model). Confounds ruled out: earlier 'killed regardless of team value' results were a broken openssl pkcs12 extraction (missing -legacy -> empty cert files -> ad-hoc fallback), corrected here (leaf+2 chain certs verified, Apple CAs auto-registered, Apple timestamp used).
